exposure: July 7 availability was inspected previously; July 8-11 were not replayed. Freeze all rules before any outcome inspection. No fitting or tuning between development and evaluation.
prior_experiment: The fixed-grid OFI V1 remains stopped at its unchanged 70 percent availability gate. This is a separate event-sampled experiment, not a passing rerun.
decision_clock: First completed target F_LAST event at or after the previous decision receive time plus 1 second; no synthetic clock-grid decisions
event_features: Completed-event best-level OFI, normalized by current mean best-side depth; queue-weighted midpoint offset is a queue proxy, not an independent microprice model
feature_boundary: Include the current completed event and prior completed events with receive time >= decision time minus 5 seconds; never include unfinished or later events
primary_rule: One-tick spread, normalized OFI magnitude >=1, weighted midpoint offset magnitude >=0.15 tick, agreeing signs
control_rule: Same spread and weighted midpoint threshold without OFI gate; independent primary position schedule
inactivity_rule: No completed target quote for strictly more than 5 seconds resets OFI and requires 5 seconds of renewed observation. Record gaps including boundary silence. Quiet trading versus upstream outage cannot be distinguished by target events alone.
inactivity_exposure: Mark every entered position open when the inactivity timer fires; retain its price outcome and block a positive research conclusion if evaluation positions have such exposure
entry_expiry: Expire strictly after entry target plus 1 second, without needing a quote; start primary cooldown at that deadline plus 1 nanosecond
exit_rule: First clean completed quote at or after entry plus 15 seconds, including widened spread or late quote; flag lateness beyond 1 second without deleting the position
last_decision_rule: Do not select if decision plus maximum latency plus entry quote wait plus hold reaches or exceeds 16:00
window_end_rule: Retain every unresolved entered position; any evaluation strategy or latency with unresolved exposure blocks a positive conclusion
episode_rule: One selection per contiguous same-direction signal run observed at rate-limited decisions, one active primary per strategy
positive_research_gate: No unresolved or inactivity-exposed evaluation positions; minimum sample; primary mean after one extra tick positive both pooled and on each evaluation day. Even then require independent replication and broker execution validation.
source_quality_rule: Abort entire run on source pin, metadata, reconstruction, event completeness, timestamp or flagged-book failure. Do not publish successful subsets or automatically change this protocol.
